properties.name: Rasuwagadhi Hydroelectric Project
properties.notes: Location: centroid of OSM way 1552793903; 0.1 km from the centreline. Geometry is the OSM way 'Rasuwagadhi Hydropower Dam' (headworks); the powerhouse is in Timure per the operator. Status 'operational' = COD 31 Dec 2024 (operator) / 2081-09-16 BS (DoED), i.e. before the 26 Aug 2026 event.

properties.name: Upper Trishuli 3A Hydropower Project
properties.notes: Location: centroid of OSM way 1554017038; 0.1 km from the centreline. Geometry is the OSM way 'Upper Trishuli 3A Powerhouse'. DoED COD 2076-05-13 BS.

properties.name: Chilime Hydropower Plant

capacity_mw.notes: DoED licence register: 22.000 MW; operator: 22.1 MW installed.

properties.notes: Location: OSM node 982602383; 0.0 km from the centreline. Geometry is the OSM node 'Chilime Hydropower Powerhouse' near Syabrubesi; the OSM way 'Chilime Hydropower Plant' (28.179 N, 85.308 E) marks the headworks. Commissioned 25 Aug 2003 (operator).

properties.name: Trishuli Hydropower Station
properties.notes: Location: OSM node 3492358494; 0.1 km from the centreline. Geometry is an OSM power=generator node named 'Trishuli Hydropower Station'.

properties.name: Devighat Hydropower Station
properties.notes: Location: centroid of OSM way 338849229; 0.1 km from the centreline. Geometry is the OSM power=generator way named 'Devighat'.

properties.name: Upper Trishuli 3B Hydropower Project
properties.notes: Location: centre of the DoED generation-licence rectangle 27°59'12"-28°01'21" N, 85°10'11"-85°12'01" E (no OSM feature); 0.1 km from the centreline. Holds a generation licence (NEA, 2070-04-27 BS); no retrieved source states whether it is under construction or operating, so status is unknown.

properties.name: Upper Trishuli-1 Hydroelectric Project
properties.notes: Location: centroid of OSM way 1552864314; 0.1 km from the centreline. Geometry is the OSM way 'Upper Trishuli-1 Hydroelectric Project' near Mailung, inside the DoED licence rectangle. Neither retrieved source states a commissioning date, so status is unknown. OSM construction ways named 'Upper Trishuli-3 Hydropower Project' (28.08-28.13 N) fall inside this licence rectangle and were not used.

properties.name: Sanjen Hydroelectric Project
properties.notes: Location: centre of the DoED licence rectangle 28°11'-28°13' N, 85°16'30"-85°18'15" E; operator: powerhouse in Chilime village at 1,745 m (no OSM feature); 5.6 km from the centreline. On the Sanjen Khola (tributary), not on the corridor centreline. DoED COD 2081-09-01 BS.

properties.name: Sanjen (Upper) Hydroelectric Project
properties.notes: Location: centre of the DoED licence rectangle 28°13'-28°14'25" N, 85°16'30"-85°18'15" E; operator: powerhouse in Simbu village at 2,187 m (no OSM feature); 6.5 km from the centreline. On the Sanjen Khola (tributary), not on the corridor centreline. DoED COD 2080-06-21 BS.

properties.name: Rasuwagadhi-Kerung (Gyirong) border post: customs and immigration
properties.notes: Location: OSM node 992955542; 0.1 km from the centreline. Located at the OSM 'Rasuwa Gadhi' hamlet node; the Customs Office Rasuwa states its address as Timure, ~3 km south. No retrieved source gives a post-August-2026 operating status.

properties.name: Nepal-China Friendship (Miteri) Bridge, Rasuwagadhi
properties.notes: Location: centroid of OSM way 1552746560; 0.0 km from the centreline. Geometry is the OSM way tagged 'Temporary Friendship Bridge in Rasuwagadhi'. Press (Republica, 26 Dec 2025) reports the bridge washed away by the July 2025 Lhende flood and rebuilt; no official confirmation and no post-August-2026 status were retrieved, so status is unknown.
